ad_library.summary: PNR Sunrise Energies ran its first captured ad on 12 November 2026 - two days before this sweep - and it recruits channel partners rather than homeowners, making them the youngest advertiser in the batch and the only one whose paid message aims at the trade. The site behind it is the most complete of the five: a working solar calculator, a six-step process, four named projects with generation figures, three named testimonials and detailed management bios. It is also the one with every hero counter reading zero, no email address, and no sitemap.
